personality_one_liner: A high-performance, dark-mode command center that feels like a premium iOS SaaS tool, featuring OLED-friendly surfaces and vibrant, gamified rings to motivate movement.

spacing.rule: Generous padding around structural containers with tight, disciplined grouping inside stat blocks.

do's: Use for a floating tab bar to create a 'Liquid Glass' iOS 26 SaaS feel.
Use for sticky headers over the scrollable dashboard.
Use on premium featured cards layered over imagery.
dont's: Never apply to dense form fields or body text regions.
Never use on small list items.
Never stack more than 2 glass surfaces on a single screen.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: A live, dynamic view of daily progress featuring a massive gamified step counter ring.

states.empty: No tracking data yet - 'Take your first step' prompt.
states.error: Failed to sync Health data. Show retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky glass header. Large central Hero section containing the step counter ring. Below, a 2-column grid of secondary metrics (Calories, Active Minutes, Distance). Top-to-bottom layout with a floating glass bottom tab bar.

screens.name: Stats & Trends
screens.purpose: Detailed historical view of step counts and health metrics.

states.loading: Skeleton bars mimicking the bar chart.
states.empty: Illustration of sneakers on a track, waiting for data.
states.error: Failed to load historical data. Retry button.

screens.layout: Pill-based segmented control at the top (Daily/Weekly/Monthly). A large bar chart taking up the top half, followed by stacked list rows for 'Highlights' and 'Insights'.

screens.name: Achievements
screens.purpose: Gamification center showing earned badges, current streaks, and milestones.

states.empty: No badges earned yet. 'Walk 10,000 steps today to unlock your first badge.'

screens.layout: Grid layout (3-column) for unlocked and locked badges. A featured top card for 'Current Streak' layered with the abstract streak background image and a gradient scrim.

screens.name: Profile Setup
screens.purpose: Configuration screen for user biometrics, AI goals, and app settings.
screens.layout: Single-column form. Labels above inputs. Use segmented pill controls instead of dropdowns for Gender and Activity Level. Sticky CTA 'Save Profile' floating at the bottom above the safe area.

abstract_streak.alt: Abstract colorful light streaks indicating motion and speed

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the Dark-First Utility personality: Use the provided Deep Obsidian background with Electric Lime accents.
Implement 'Liquid Glass' aesthetics for the floating bottom tab bar and sticky headers. This requires using expo-blur over surfaceSecondary.
The Home dashboard must feature a large, dominant circular progress ring for the daily step goal. Make it thick and vibrant.
Use 'Barlow Condensed' for all major numeric values (step count, calories, streaks, timers) to reinforce the performance-oriented utility vibe. Use 'Satoshi' for body copy and labels.
Gamification: Build out the Achievements screen with tactile, responsive elements. When users tap a badge, provide clear haptic feedback.
For the Profile Setup screen, strictly avoid web-style dropdowns. Use native-feeling bottom sheets or horizontal scrolling pill-segmented controls.

MANDATORY SCRIM: Any time text is overlaid on the provided images (like the abstract_streak for streaks or hero_shoes for onboarding/empty states), you MUST place a vertical expo-linear-gradient scrim from 0% transparent to 70% surfaceInverse under the text to guarantee WCAG contrast.
Blue/Purple/Indigo are strictly banned from this app's palette. Ensure any default native components (like active tab tints or switch toggles) are overridden to use the `brand` token (#D4FF00).
